subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures be suppressed before mutating-tool handling in all includeDetails cases, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests encode visible detail warnings for some exec-like cases, while the PR and linked issue request a broader suppress-all policy; automation should not choose that behavior contract alone.

options.title: Revise suppression policy before merge
options.body: Move or narrow the exec-like branch only after preserving or updating the cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating exec expectations with tests and proof.

options.title: Keep detail-mode warnings
options.body: Close or narrow the linked issue if maintainers decide those includeDetails warnings are intentional product behavior.

options.title: Replace with broader normalization work
options.body: Use the related Codex `exec_command` thread to land a central exec-like normalization fix instead of merging this one-line branch.

recommendation.title: Revise suppression policy before merge
recommendation.body: Move or narrow the exec-like branch only after preserving or updating the cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating exec expectations with tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows this person worked across the tool display and mutation helper surfaces most relevant to the policy choice.
